kpis.name: Mint booked revenue
kpis.meaning: Generated Mint ticket revenue booked by the selected as-of date.
kpis.aggregation: Add fares across distinct booking IDs; never add successive cumulative as-of totals.
kpis.time_basis: Cumulative through end-of-day t, for selected departures.
kpis.eligibility: Mint bookings belonging to the selected route/departure cohort; apply selected booking channel.
kpis.missing_zero: Missing IDs, dates or fares fail validation. Valid cohort with no bookings = 0 USD. Empty departure cohort = N/A.
kpis.filters: Route + departure date + departure ID + booking channel. As-of t is a cutoff, not a booking-date equality filter.
kpis.non_additive: Do not add cumulative revenue across as-of dates or add it again to snapshot revenue.

kpis.name: Average booked Mint fare
kpis.meaning: Average generated fare per booked Mint passenger.
kpis.formula: K1 / COUNT(fact_booking.id), using identical booking filters
kpis.aggregation: Divide total fare by total booking count. Do not average route or flight averages.
kpis.time_basis: Bookings made on or before end-of-day t.
kpis.eligibility: Exactly the same booking rows as K1; one booking represents one passenger.
kpis.missing_zero: Missing required fields fail validation; zero bookings or empty departure cohort = N/A.
kpis.filters: Route + departure date + departure ID + booking channel.
kpis.non_additive: Averages cannot be summed. Recompute from numerator and denominator for each group.

kpis.name: Booked Mint seat utilization
kpis.meaning: Share of modeled Mint capacity already booked; this is not final flown load factor.
kpis.formula: 100 × SUM(fact_snapshot.booked at t) / SUM(fact_inventory.mintCapacity once per departure)
kpis.aggregation: Ratio of total booked seats to total capacity. One snapshot at t and one inventory row per departure.
kpis.time_basis: End-of-day t; capacity is assumed constant over the generated history.
kpis.eligibility: Selected route/departure cohort with a complete snapshot at t. Always all booking channels.
kpis.missing_zero: Missing snapshots or invalid counts = N/A with an error; zero capacity or empty cohort = N/A. No silent row drops.
kpis.filters: Route + departure date + departure ID + snapshot t. Booking-channel filter does not apply; label ALL CHANNELS.
kpis.non_additive: Do not sum percentages or take a simple average of flight percentages.

kpis.name: Remaining Mint seats
kpis.meaning: Modeled Mint seats not yet booked at the selected as-of date.
kpis.formula: SUM(fact_inventory.mintCapacity once per departure) − SUM(fact_snapshot.booked at t)
kpis.aggregation: Add across distinct departures at the same t. Never sum across snapshot dates.
kpis.eligibility: Same selected departures and snapshot-completeness rules as K3. Always all booking channels.
kpis.missing_zero: Missing snapshots or negative remaining inventory = error/N/A; valid sold-out cohort = 0 seats; empty cohort = N/A.
kpis.filters: Route + departure date + departure ID + snapshot t. Booking-channel filter does not apply; label ALL CHANNELS.
kpis.non_additive: Point-in-time inventory is not additive over time.

kpis.name: 7-day booking pickup
kpis.meaning: Additional generated Mint passenger bookings during the seven calendar days ending at t.
kpis.formula: COUNT(fact_booking.id) WHERE t − 7 days < bookingDate <= t
kpis.aggregation: Add distinct booking rows across selected departures/channels within this one window.
kpis.time_basis: Seven daily dates: t−6 through t, inclusive. Compare with the preceding non-overlapping window when coverage permits.
kpis.eligibility: Selected route/departure cohort and booking channel; the generated model has no cancellations/refunds.
kpis.missing_zero: Missing booking IDs/dates fail validation. Valid complete window with no bookings = 0; incomplete coverage or empty cohort = N/A.
kpis.filters: Route + departure date + departure ID + booking channel. t controls the rolling window.
kpis.non_additive: Overlapping rolling 7-day windows must not be summed. This is gross pickup; cancellations are excluded.
